blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Digital Experience > Settings & Configurations > Probes, and select which collection to add the application to.
See image.
The Add Application link is disabled if you’ve reached the maximum number of allowed applications or probes for your subscription level.
Click Add Application.
The Add Application drawer appears.
See image.
In the Add Application drawer:
If you choose Create New, you can configure the following fields:

Name: Enter a name for the custom application. The maximum length is 64 characters. Accepted characters are alphanumerics and a limited range of symbols: underscore (_), hyphen (-), space ( ), forward slash (/), backward slash (\), period (.), at symbol (@), pipe symbol (|), and parentheses ().
Status: Toggle to enable or disable the application.
If an application is disabled, then the application disables its probes.
Enable Real User Monitoring: Toggle to enable or disable Real User Monitoring (RUM). If RUM is enabled, configure the following:
Domain URL: Enter the domain URL.

If you define a domain URL as https://domain.com, then it is also defined as https://www.domain.com. You must define subdomain URLs as a separate URL from the domain URL (e.g., https://subdomain.domain.com). If you are configuring for a subdomain URL, you must configure another custom application to specifically capture metrics for the subdomain.
Session Timeout: Select the duration at which a user's session in the application times out due to inactivity.
See image.
Application Type: Select either Custom or Network. Network applications do not require a Web probe, and require only one Cloud Path probe. To learn more, see Monitoring the Applications Overview.
Description: (Optional) Enter the description of the application.
If you choose Select from existing, you can search and then select an existing application.
See image.
You cannot select a disabled application.
Click Add.
Activate your changes.

blocks.text: After you save the application, you can configure probes for it, then edit the status.
